_meta.purpose: T4 term-normalization ALIAS file — a small, lawyer-reviewable layman->statutory lexicon. Each entry maps one or more colloquial/layman surface forms (aliases) that a non-expert would type to the STATUTORY register term(s) the corpus actually uses. It exists to bridge the ZERO-LEXICAL-OVERLAP gap (e.g. 'cookies' vs the statute's 'koncove zarizeni') that a tsvector keyword seed cannot cross on its own. Consumed by pythia/graph/term_norm.py ONLY when config.term_norm_enabled is True (default OFF). PURE data; no code.
_meta.status: DRAFT — ADVOCATE/LAWYER REVIEW PENDING. Seed set authored deterministically from the corpus register; every alias->statutory mapping must be confirmed by counsel before the flag is flipped ON in any serving env. The 'note' field records the intended statutory hook for that review; it is NOT consumed by code.

schema.aliases: list[str] — layman surface forms (lowercased match); a query token/phrase matching any of these fires the entry
schema.statutory: list[str] — the statutory-register term(s) injected as an exact-term-boosted sparse leg
schema.note: str — the intended statutory hook / act, for the reviewer only (not read by code)
